recent.text: With the results of today, the #Bears go from 1st place to 3rd place in a three-way tie at 7-2. The NFC North continues to be historically good. Tie-breakers aren't going the Bears' way right now, but they'll have 4 divisional games to change that coming out of the bye week.
recent.author: Aaron Leming

recent.text: Jeffery Simmons is an absolute menace and a game-changer. But with that Vikings D, all they needed was a QB who could manage the game to become a legit SB contender. It’s close, but Cousins completely changes the ceiling of that team. #DaBears
recent.author: Clay Harbor
